arguments.summary: A credential compromise occurred on host WS-FIN-AP01, originating from malicious activity traced to external IP 185.220.101.42. Investigation revealed a phishing-based initial access vector involving Outlook spawning encoded PowerShell, leading to execution of a malicious DLL via rundll32 from the user's Temp directory. The host exhibited C2 beaconing behavior over port 443. Although EDR flagged suspicious behaviors (T1566.001, T1218.011, T1071.001), sandbox analysis returned a false negative. The external IP was previously observed conducting an Nmap scan against an internal IT asset (WS-IT-101). The firewall has since blocked the C2 IP. A full endpoint scan detected a low-severity PUP but no primary malware payload, likely due to fileless execution. No privilege escalation or lateral movement was confirmed during the investigation window.

The IP was blocked at the firewall, and a full endpoint scan identified a low-severity PUP. The host was remediated via Ansible playbook.
